schedule.layer_launch: retained valid/ready request for the active layer
schedule.layer_completion: accept exactly one matching, fault-free completion
schedule.checkpoint: emit and retain one checkpoint after every accepted layer completion
schedule.transition: launch layer N+1 only after checkpoint N is accepted
schedule.terminal: emit token completion only after checkpoint 23 is accepted

causes: early, duplicate, mismatched, unknown, or faulted layer completion

established: one checkpoint-gated RTL trajectory across all 24 layer indices
retained metadata under launch, checkpoint, and terminal backpressure
fail-closed protocol handling and clear recovery
excluded: synthesis, timing, PPA, FPGA, or silicon
